syr.translation: abbr. Syracuse;  New York 美国; 纽约州; Syria 叙利亚共和国

syracuse.definition:
n. a city in central New York
n. a city in southeastern Sicily that was founded by Corinthians in the 8th century BC
n. the Roman siege of Syracuse (214-212 BC) was eventually won by the Romans who sacked the city (killing Archimedes)
syracuse.translation: n. 锡拉库扎（意大利西西里岛东部一港市）

syrette.translation: n. <美>(容纳一次剂量的可套缩的)西雷特皮下注射器

syria.definition: n. an Asian republic in the Middle East at the east end of the Mediterranean; site of some of the world's most ancient centers of civilization
syria.translation:
n. 叙利亚
[经] 叙利亚

syriac.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to Syria, or its language; as, the Syriac
   version of the Pentateuch.
n. The language of Syria; especially, the ancient language of
   that country.

syriacism.definition: n. A Syrian idiom; a Syrianism.
syriacism.translation: n. 古代叙利亚语风格

syriam.translation: 沙廉[缅甸南部港市](或译锡里安)

syrian.definition:
n. a native or inhabitant of Syria
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Syria or its people or culture
syrian.translation:
n. 叙利亚人, 叙利亚语
a. 叙利亚语的, 叙利亚人的

syrian arab republic.translation: [网络] 叙利亚；阿拉伯叙利亚共和国；利亚阿拉伯共和国

syrian desert.translation:
na. 叙利亚大沙漠
[网络] 叙利亚沙漠；巨型骆驼之乡叙利亚沙漠

syrian hamster.translation: 叙利亚仓鼠；金丝熊（等于golden hamster）

syrian pound.translation: [网络] 叙利亚镑；叙利亚叙利亚镑；叙利亚磅

syrians.definition: n. a native or inhabitant of Syria

syringa.definition: n. genus of Old World shrubs or low trees having fragrant flowers in showy panicles: lilacs
syringa.translation: n. 山梅花, 丁香花

syringa persica.translation: [网络] 花叶丁香；波斯丁香

syringa reticulata.translation: [网络] 暴马丁香；北京丁香；日本树丁香

syringa villosa.translation: [网络] 红丁香；丁香园内栽植了红丁香；丁香属

syringa vulgaris.translation: [网络] 欧丁香；紫丁香；欧洲丁香

syringaldehyde.translation: [化] 丁香醛; 4-羟-3,5-二甲氧苯甲醛

syringe.definition:
n. a medical instrument used to inject or withdraw fluids
v. spray or irrigate (a body part) with a syringe
syringe.translation:
n. 注射器, 洗涤器
vt. 注射, 洗涤

syringeal.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to the syrinx; as, the syringeal
   muscle.
syringeal.translation: a. (鸟的)鸣管的,与鸣管连接的

syringed.translation: vt. 注射（syringe的过去式与过去分词形式）

syringes.definition:
n a primitive wind instrument consisting of several parallel pipes bound together
n the vocal organ of a bird
v spray or irrigate (a body part) with a syringe

syringic acid.translation: [化] 4-羟基-3,5-二甲氧基苯甲酸; 丁香酸

syringin.definition:
n. A glucoside found in the bark of the lilac (Syringa) and
   extracted as a white crystalline substance; -- formerly called also
   lilacin.
syringin.translation:
[化] 丁香苷; 女贞素; 甲氧基松柏苷
[医] [紫]丁香甙

syringing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Syringe

syringocoele.definition: n. The central canal of the spinal cord.

syringoid.translation: [医] 管样的, 瘘管样的

syringomyelia atrophica.translation: [医] 萎缩性脊髓空洞症, 空洞性脊髓炎

syringomyelic dissociation.translation: [医] 脊髓空洞症性感觉分离

syringotome.definition:
n. A small blunt-pointed bistoury, -- used in
   syringotomy.

syringotomy.definition: n. The operation of cutting for anal fistula.

syrinx.definition: n. the vocal organ of a bird
syrinx.translation:
n. 排箫, 鸣管
[医] 瘘管, 咽鼓管, 鸣管(鸟类)

syrinxes.translation: 潘神销, （鸟的）鸣管, 耳管( syrinx的名词复数 )

syrosingopine.translation: [化] 昔洛舍平; 乙酯利血平

syrphian.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to the syrphus flies.
n. A syrphus fly.

syrrhaptes.translation: [网络] 毛腿沙鸡属；援毛腿沙鸡

syrtic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to a syrt; resembling syrt, or quicksand.

syrup.definition: n. a thick sweet sticky liquid
syrup.translation:
n. 糖浆, 果汁
[化] 糖浆剂

syruped.definition:
a. Moistened, covered, or sweetened with sirup, or sweet
   juice.
syruped.translation: n. 糖浆, 果汁；含药糖浆

syrups.definition: n. a thick sweet sticky liquid
syrups.translation: n. 糖浆, 糖汁( syrup的复数形式 ); 糖浆类药品

syrupy.definition: s. having a relatively high resistance to flow
syrupy.translation: a. 糖浆的, 糖浆状的, 甜蜜的, 美妙的, 太甜的, 伤感的
